title: The union of sets
competency: Determine the union of two sets and show it on a Venn diagram.

keywords.def: A ∪ B: all elements that belong to A or B or both.

en.text: The union of A and B, written A ∪ B, is the set of all elements in A or B or both. List A, then add the elements of B that are not there yet. If A = {3, 4, 5, 6} and B = {4, 6, 8, 10}, A ∪ B = {3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10}.

screens.title: Two clubs
screens.ask: The football club has {Abel, Bethel, Chala}. The drama club has {Bethel, Dawit}. Who is in at least one club?
screens.after: Put everyone together, but write Bethel once. That is the union.

screens.title: 1.3.1 The union of sets
paras: Definition 1.6: The union of A and B, written A ∪ B and read "A union B", is the set of all elements in A or B or both.
On a Venn diagram, A ∪ B is both circles, shaded together.

screens.title: Find A ∪ B
steps: Look at B = {4, 6, 8, 10}. 4 and 6 are already listed.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A ∪ B: all elements that belong to A or B or both.

screens.text: A = {3, 4, 5, 6} and B = {4, 6, 8, 10}. Tap every element of A ∪ B.
screens.why: A ∪ B = {3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10}. 7 is in neither set.
screens.clue: Everything in A, plus everything in B.

screens.text: A = {a, e, i, o} and B = {a, e, i}. A ∪ B = ?
opts: {a, a, e, e, i, i, o}
screens.why: Every element of B is already in A. So A ∪ B = A.

screens.text: P = {1, 3, 5} and Q = {2, 3, 4}. Tap every element of P ∪ Q.
screens.clue: List P, then add the new elements of Q.

screens.ask: A = {2, 4} and B = {4, 6, 8}. A ∪ B has ___ elements.

screens.text: A ∪ B = {1, 2, 3, 4} and A = {1, 2}. Which could B be?
screens.why: B must give the missing 3 and 4, and add nothing new. {3, 4} works: {1, 2} ∪ {3, 4} = {1, 2, 3, 4}.
screens.clue: Which elements of A ∪ B are missing from A?

screens.title: ∈ and ∉
steps: A set lists its elements between braces: A = {3, 4, 5}.
3 ∈ A means 3 is an element of A.
8 ∉ A means 8 is not an element of A.

test.text: A = {1, 2} and B = {2, 5}. Tap every element of A ∪ B.

test.ask: A = {a, b, c} and B = {c, d}. A ∪ B has ___ elements.

test.text: If every element of A is in B, then A ∪ B = ?
test.why: A adds nothing new to B.

test.ask: A = {1, 2, 3} and A ∪ B = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}. B must contain 4 and ___
test.why: The union has 4 and 5, which are not in A. So both must come from B.

notes.text: Example 2 writes "A = {a, e, i}" for the second set; it should be B = {a, e, i}. Shown as B.
